versions.changelog:
- Removed the file: skill-card.md.
- No changes to code or functionality.  
- Documentation and skill description remain unchanged.

- Added new directories: `references` and `scripts` to organize supporting documentation and executable files.
- Removed outdated `skill-card.md` documentation file.
- No changes to user-facing features; organizational update to improve file structure and maintainability.

- Initial release of Apartment Scorecard.
- Compare and rank rental listings with hard constraints (budget, bedrooms, pets, commute, move date).
- Score finalists on 16 customizable, weighted criteria reflecting your priorities.
- Computes true all-in monthly cost including all fees, utilities, insurance, and amortized costs.
- Offers affordability analysis (30/33/50% income rules, 3x income approval).
- Generates tailored negotiation scripts based on listing facts and leverage.
- Supports JSON or CSV listing inputs; command-line workflow for screening, comparing, budgeting, and negotiation.
